description: Instrumentation fork of exp428 (the goal-aligned SOTA, 1.4983) — config IDENTICAL to exp428, no model changes. Adds effective_lr.csv logging the REAL Adam per-step lr per module group: nominal_lr (base*cosine scale) and adam_factor_rms = rms(m_hat/(sqrt(v_hat)+eps)) in [0,1] (gradient consistency / realized fraction of nominal lr), and eff_step_rms = nominal*factor. Answers: what real lr does each part of the model see and how does it evolve through warmup/peak/decay.
